body:
Welcome to the **Content Creator Pack!** (standed for CCP for short)
In this Mod, there are tons of Features that Minecraft Content Creators use, for example Parrot, Wifies, Wemmbu.

# IMPORTANT FOR FLASHBACK!!
## if trying to _save_ your recording on **Flashback**, the Game might crash since Distant Horizons is trying to not communicate with Iris, i tried fixing the problem and i can't fix it. So you have to **Record** on your Recording App til the end.
----------------------
**_WHAT IS CONTENT CREATOR PACK?_**

- **_Content Creator Pack_**, in short **CCP**, is a ModPack where Mods have put into one, meaning every Content Creator or almost every Content Creator uses.

----------------------
**_WHAT IS IN THIS MOD?_**

In this ModPack, i have added **[EMF] Entity Model Features**, EMF is an, OptiFine format, Custom Entity Model replacement mod available for Fabric and Forge. **[ETF] Entity Texture Features**, Emissive, Random & Custom texture support for entities in resourcepacks just like Optifine but for Fabric. **3D Skin Layers**, Render the player skin layer in 3d. **BetterF3**, BetterF3 is a mod that replaces Minecraft's original debug HUD with a highly customizable, more human-readable HUD. **Camera Utils**, Helpful camera utilities which are the following: Dynamic zoom, Camera detaching, Adjustable third person distance, Two customizable third person perspectives, Advanced cinematic camera controls, Movement smoothing. **Chat Animation [Smooth Chat]**, Makes chat messages appear with a smooth animation. **Distant Horizons**, See farther without turning your game into a slide show. **Essential Mod**, Enhance your Minecraft with one simple mod. Host worlds for free, chat with friends, and so much more! **Fabric API**, Lightweight and modular API providing common hooks and intercompatibility measures utilized by mods using the Fabric toolchain. **Fabric Language Kotlin**, This is a mod that enables usage of the Kotlin programming language for Fabric mods. **Flashback**, Record your Minecraft gameplay, play it back and create stunning cinematic shots. **Green Screen**, Chromakey blocks for easy screenshotting or video recording. **Iris Shaders**, A modern shader pack loader for Minecraft intended to be compatible with existing OptiFine shader packs. **MakeUp - Ultra Fast**, MakeUp aims to provide the best quality / performance ratio, building a shader that can be adapted to anyone's resources. **Mod Menu**, Adds a mod menu to view the list of mods you have installed. **More Chat History**, Increases the maximum length of chat history. **Motion Capture**, Allows you to record and replay player movements. **Simple Voice Chat**, A working voice chat in Minecraft. **Smooth Skies**, Smooths out the skybox colors on far render distances and fixes some other skybox visual issues. **SmoothHud**, animate the selected hotbar slot highlight when switching slots. **Sodium**, A high-performance rendering engine replacement for Minecraft, which greatly improves frame rates and reduces micro-stutter. **Text Placeholder API**, Placeholder and Text manipulation library for your Minecraft mods. **WorldEdit**, A Minecraft Map Editor... that runs in-game! With selections, schematics, copy and paste, brushes, and scripting. Use it in creative, or use it. **YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL)**, A builder-based configuration library for Minecraft. **Zoomify (Zoom)**, A zoom mod with infinite customizability. Here are also every Shader i have added to make the Game look more fancy: **AstraLex Shaders**, **Bliss Shaders**, **BSL Shaders**, **Complementary Shaders - Reimagined**, **Complementary Shaders - Unbound**, **Photon Shaders**, **Sildur's Vibrant Shaders**, **Solas Shader**.
